title: Customer Network ROI Prioritizer and Simplified Onboarding Paths for Private/VPC Requests
creator: Samira Khan
description:
Background: We continue to receive a high volume of private/VPC/on-prem intake requests that vary significantly in business value, network complexity, and time-to-ship. Current manual triage consumes PM/SE bandwidth, creates inconsistent outcomes, and lengthens customer lead time. This ticket proposes a lightweight 'Network ROI Prioritizer' (NRP) plus a small set of simplified onboarding pathways to: (1) surface high-value customers to the fast-track lane, (2) route medium-complexity requests to a templated standard onboarding, and (3) defer low ROI or high-risk requests with clear remediation paths.

Goals: Provide an operational rubric and automation mapping that: 1) reduces PM triage time by >=50% for inbound private/VPC requests; 2) increases proportion of high-value requests placed into FastTrack or Concierge lanes from baseline by 30%; 3) lowers average time-to-first-successful-test-deploy for Standard lane from 6 weeks to 3 weeks; 4) creates repeatable artifacts (intake form mappings, comms templates, SE checklist) usable by onboarding and growth teams.

High-level approach: Build a deterministic scoring model (0-100) combining business signals and technical signals. Map scores to three onboarding paths: FastTrack (score >=75), Standard (40-74), Defer/Remediation (<40). Allow hard gates for regulatory constraints (e.g., export controls) and for air-gapped customers that must go to Concierge even if score is lower. Capture inputs from the intake form and augment with automated probes where possible (network reachability, egress fingerprinting). Produce a one-page decision card for each request with recommended lane, primary risk drivers, and required engineering preconditions.

Scoring rubric (proposed weights):
- Business value (ARR / strategic): 35 points. Signals: customer ARR band (>500k = 35, 100-500k = 20, <100k = 5), strategic partnership flag (+10), pilot-to-production plan (+5).
- Network friction: 25 points (lower friction = higher points). Signals: open egress (25), restricted egress with proxy (12), fully air-gapped requiring physical media (0).
- Security & compliance overhead: 20 points. Signals: SOC2/ISO in place (+10), required HSM/KMS integration (-5 if no integration path), legal export restrictions (-20 hard block flag).
- Time sensitivity / launch date: 10 points. Signals: committed launch within 90 days (+10), exploratory proof-of-concept (-5).
- Engineering effort estimate: 10 points (lower effort higher score). Signals: standard VPC peering and VPC endpoints (10), requires custom kernel/quantization changes (0).

Edge rules and overrides:
- Any request flagged as 'export control' or 'regulated data residency' is routed to Concierge regardless of score.
- If customer requires nightly airgap updates with no remote agent, add 0 points to network friction and trigger security review.
- Existing Dedicated customers with reserved capacity get +5 business value bonus.

Automation & mapping:
- Intake form fields required: company ARR bracket, pilot/prod timeline, network diagram upload, egress constraints (Y/N + description), requires HSM/KMS (Y/N), maintenance window availability, preferred region, contact SE.
- Intake => NRP service: map form values to score model, auto-generate decision card, and send recommended lane to PM slack channel with triage URL.
- Optional probes: automated network probe (customer-run container) to detect egress capability and measure latency to our regions; results feed into network friction signal.

Onboarding path definitions and runbooks:
- FastTrack (>=75): PM + SE concierge. Deliver within 2-6 weeks. Requirements: completed preflight, SE pre-checks, access to maintenance window, signed AUP. Runbook: 1) assign concierge, 2) schedule preflight call, 3) provision test env, 4) run probe, 5) verify token/KMS access, 6) staged rollout.
- Standard (40-74): Self-serve assisted template. Deliver within 1-3 weeks for initial smoke test. Requirements: standard VPC peering, limited egress rules. Runbook: 1) provide templated VPC firewall rules, 2) guide for certs/KMS integration, 3) standard upgrade path documentation, 4) common troubleshooting playbook.
- Defer / Remediation (<40): PM to communicate remediation steps and expected timeline. Provide a remediation checklist and recommended third-party partners for complex tunnels, baselining network readiness checklist. Allow re-evaluation after remediation or change in business signals.

Acceptance criteria (see field below) and metrics to track (KR): number of intakes processed by NRP, triage time reduction, % of requests in each lane, average time-to-deploy by lane, SE hours spent per intake.

Stakeholders: Growth SEs, Enterprise Sales, Solutions Engineering, Platform Reliability Eng, Security & Compliance, Legal, Documentation/Developer Experience.

Artifacts & links (placeholders): Intake form draft (Confluence), NRP scoring spreadsheet (Drive), Slack triage channel (#pm-private-triage), Onboarding templates repo (GitHub), SE checklist (Confluence). Add real links during implementation.

Risks & mitigations: Risk - scoring under/over-prioritizes due to noisy ARR signal. Mitigation - monitor outcomes for 8 weeks and recalibrate weights. Risk - customers feel deferred; Mitigation - provide clear remediation steps and optional paid concierge. Risk - probe false negatives; Mitigation - require human SE confirmation for borderline cases.

Rollout plan: 1) Build scoring pilot and run on last 90 days of intake to validate distribution (2 weeks, PM+Data); 2) Implement basic automation to populate decision cards and post to PM slack (3 weeks, Eng); 3) Trial FastTrack on 5 inbound requests (4 weeks); 4) Iterate weights and publish runbooks and templates (2 weeks); 5) GA and monitor metrics (ongoing).
acceptance_criteria: NRP pilot runs over historical 90-day intake and produces score distribution and sample decision cards (dataset attached).
Automation posts recommended lane to #pm-private-triage with a link to decision card for >=90% of new intakes.
PM triage time for inbound private/VPC requests reduced by >=50% in pilot compared to baseline.
FastTrack, Standard, and Defer runbooks exist in Confluence and include checklists and SE playbooks.
Metrics dashboard created (intakes processed, average score, lane distribution, time-to-deploy by lane, SE hours per intake).
